Honesty Gate — published 2026-08-18

Our own fine-tunes are losing our own arena

Council of AI publishes the result that embarrasses it: our two sovereign fine-tunes lose to the base models we started from, in our own 16-axis arena, on our own GPU. We trained them. We measure them. They lose. We publish it — and you can recompute it.

This page is the most credible thing we can publish. A measurer publishing a result that embarrasses it is what pulls outsiders in. The numbers below are live from the arena league on our measurement pod, updated continuously.

What it means — and doesn't

"This governs provenance, not correctness. An attested answer is attested, never verified."
  • Does mean: adapter-souping weak bases does not beat the base. The measurement rail works — it caught us.
  • Does NOT mean: the instruments are broken. The instrument that shows us losing is the same one we sell. That is the point.
  • Recompute path: reborn_league.json on the pod, ~3,700+ signed rounds, Elo K=32, 16-axis battery. Any stranger can rerun a card on their own machine.
